h: Old Town Charm and a Racing Legend's Hometown
p: Stevenage might be known for its New Town roots, but it has an older side too. The Old Town High Street, at the northern end of town, still has historic buildings, pubs and independent shops, and it feels like a different place compared with the modern centre. It's well worth a wander if you want a sit-down meal or a cuppa somewhere with a bit of character.

Formula 1 fans may already know this: seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton grew up in Stevenage. The town is proud of him, and it's a good bit of trivia for budding racers in the car on the way home.

Just south of the centre, the Six Hills are a row of Roman burial mounds sitting right by the main road, a quirky reminder of how much history lies under the modern town. Kids tend to love the idea that the Romans were here long before the roundabouts and cycleways.

Beyond town, Hitchin is a charming market town close by with a lively market, and Letchworth Garden City, the world's first garden city, is next door. Both make a good follow-up if you want more to explore after your session. Back at Gravity, remember the basics: waivers online, water bottles packed and grip socks saved for next time.
